protocol: Fresh process per variant and concurrency, stock then native. Concurrency 2 and 4; no paired blocks. No positive paired count at displayed precision, so these runs provide separate latency diagnostics, not ABBA confirmation or a promotion gate.
cache_budget: Auto, observed 5134 expert slots (63.92 GiB) in paired logs; expert cache initialized afresh per process. Operating-system page cache is shared across processes.
latency_semantics: Each measured batch step advances every stream by one token. The reported step mean/p95 is the per-stream inter-token round duration, not step latency divided by concurrency.
